MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Ecology and Ecosystems.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Buoyancy, locomotion and movement in fishes.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Fish culture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Fish culture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Fish culture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Fish culture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Fish culture.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish feeds and feeding? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish feeds and feeding.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish feeds and feeding.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish feeds and feeding.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish feeds and feeding.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of marine and freshwater environments? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of marine and freshwater environments.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond.

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of Marine and Freshwater Environments 3.2 Weather and Climatic Cond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation of marine and freshwater environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climatic Conditions in Marine and Freshwater 3.3 Fishery by-products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
